description: Agritech Limited is a fertilizer manufacturer incorporated in Pakistan on 15 December 1959 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It owns and operates a urea plant at Iskanderabad, District Mianwali, and a single super phosphate plant at Hattar Road, District Haripur — which it describes as the country's largest SSP plant. Its fertilizers are sold under the brand name Tara.
headOffice: 4th Floor, Askari Corporate Tower, 75-76, Block D-1, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
